title: render-worker is barely making progress despite idle CPU cores
description_md:
`render-worker` is supposed to be chewing through its job queue continuously, but its throughput has collapsed to a crawl -- and `top` shows this box has cores sitting idle while `render-worker` limps along. Nothing about the job itself changed. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out why a process can be CPU-starved on a box with free capacity to spare, and fix it.

You're done when `render-worker` is actually making healthy forward progress again.
